title: Measures to Promote Flexible Work Arrangements for Work-life Harmony and to Facilitate Caregivers and Women Returning to Workforce
what_it_is: Measures to Promote Flexible Work Arrangements for Work-life Harmony and to Facilitate Caregivers and Women Returning to Workforce

sections.label: Questions on caregivers and flexible work
sections.summary: Questions ask about TAFEP mediation issues on flexible work arrangements, studies on their impact, and caregiving's effect on careers and finances.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) in the past year, what are the common issues brought up to the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) in relation to mediation cases on flexible work arrangements (FWAs); and (b) whether there have been any studies conducted on the impact of FWAs on work-life harmony and performance appraisals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry is studying the impact of caregiving on a caregiver's career, finances and retirement adequacy; (b) in the last three years, how many caregivers have to (i) give up their jobs and (ii) switch to part-time jobs in order to provide care for an elderly family member, respectively; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider some financial support for such caregivers.

sections.label: Women outside labour force reasons
sections.summary: In 2020, 15% of women cited family responsibilities as the main reason for being outside the labour force, and 6% worked part-time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In 2020, 15% of women cited family-related responsibilities as the main reason for being outside the labour force, while 6% were working part-time due to family or personal commitments.

sections.label: Workfare Income Supplement for caregivers
sections.summary: Eligible working caregivers receive Workfare Income Supplement, providing up to $4,000 in cash and CPF top-ups annually for lower-wage earners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Eligible working caregivers receive Workfare Income Supplement, which provides up to $4,000 in cash and CPF top-ups annually for those earning lower wages.

sections.label: Feedback for Women's Development White Paper
sections.summary: Feedback from Singapore Women's Development conversations on greater caregiver support will be considered for the upcoming White Paper.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Feedback from the conversations on Singapore Women's Development on greater support for caregivers will also be considered for the upcoming White Paper on Singapore Women's Development.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work Arrangements
sections.summary: The Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work Arrangements recognises companies offering such arrangements and recommended practices, including informing employees and evaluating requests.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Today, we have the Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work Arrangements (FWA), which provides recognition to companies that offer flexible work arrangements to their employees and put in place recommended practices, including informing employees on the flexible work arrangements available and the process to evaluate requests from their employees.

sections.label: Tripartite Advisory on Flexible Work Arrangements
sections.summary: The Tripartite Advisory on Flexible Work Arrangements states supervisors should communicate expectations upfront, appraise based on outcomes not face time, and conduct regular check-ins.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: For example, the Tripartite Advisory on Flexible Work Arrangements sets out that supervisors should communicate expectations clearly upfront, manage and appraise fairly based on work outcomes instead of face time and also have to conduct regular check-ins with staff who are on flexible work arrangements.

sections.label: MOM outreach to elderly jobseekers
sections.summary: MOM has reached out to elderly jobseekers, set up 24 SGUnited Jobs and Skills Centres in HDB estates, and caregivers can use the MrCareersFuture portal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Indeed, one of MOM's focus in the last two years has been reaching out to elderly jobseekers, caregivers included, to make sure that they are able to navigate the wide spectrum of resources available.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We have also set up 24 SGUnited Jobs and Skills Centres in HDB estates and these actually have been tremendously helpful, as senior jobseekers, caregivers included, are able to walk in and have face-to-face type of consultation sessions with the career advisers on the spot.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Caregivers can also tap on the MrCareersFuture portal to search for jobs that best suit their skill sets and I think this is widely available and known to all.
